item.name: Strength
item.effect: Lets you move bigger rocks and reach stronger rarity gates.
item.cost: Cash prices scale by level; Robux shortcut available.
item.priority: Upgrade first when a rock gate is slowing your route.
item.cardSummary: Strength is the main progress upgrade. If a rock barely moves or a rarity lane is out of reach, Strength is the upgrade that fixes it.

item.name: Carry
item.effect: Raises how many rescued Brainrots you can carry before returning home.
item.cost: Cash price by level; optional Robux shortcut.
item.priority: Upgrade after Strength when return trips start wasting time.
item.cardSummary: Carry is a routing upgrade. It matters once you can reach better Brainrots and want fewer trips back to base.

item.name: Rebirth
item.effect: Trades progress for stronger long-term multipliers and more spots.
item.priority: Use when the next multiplier is worth rebuilding your route.
item.cardSummary: Rebirth is the long-term reset system. It boosts the account after you can afford the listed cash requirement.
